I feel like anyone who has been an adult longer than ten minutes has experienced this phenomena in some area of their life (if you say you haven't you are lying). I know the meter maid comes at a specific time so I leave and drive around for a few minutes to avoid the ticket. Sometimes it works well because I have errands to run, sometimes it doesn't because I have no where to go for that few 20 minutes. Then the whole time I'm going in circles I'm rolling my eyes thinking about how stupid the whole scenario is.

What about you?
Have you ever had to do something really stupid, that you knew was stupid at the time, but the realities of life forced to have to do it anyway, and you just laughed about it because it was so dumb?

I suppose it's story time, then!
